mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,task_id,execution_id,user_id,domain,session_id,request_id,fingerprint,policy_id,policy_version_id,actions_json FROM ai_memory_proposal_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_proposal_batch SET actions_json=#{actions} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} AND JSON_LENGTH(actions_json)=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_memory_item(tenant_id,id,subject_type,subject_id,owner_id,domain,origin_top_agent_id,scope_type,scope_id,purpose,field_key,lifecycle) VALUES(#{item.tenantId},#{item.id},#{item.subjectType},#{item.subjectId},#{item.ownerId},#{item.domain},#{item.originTopAgentId},#{item.scopeType},#{item.scopeId},#{item.purpose},#{item.fieldKey},'LIVE') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_memory_proposal WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM ai_memory_proposal WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM ai_memory_proposal WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM ai_memory_proposal WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND user_id=#{user} AND domain=#{domain} AND top_level_agent_id=#{domain} AND session_id=#{session} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT content_hmac FROM ai_memory_proposal WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND item_id=#{item} AND status='PENDING' AND encrypted_payload IS NOT NULL AND expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_proposal SET status=CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN #{status} ELSE status END,revision=revision+1, encrypted_payload=NULL,nonce=NULL,auth_tag=NULL,content_hmac=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND id=#{row.id} AND revision=#{row.revision} AND encrypted_payload IS NOT NULL
